summary: Southport Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its Form S-1 on September 30, 2026 and the October 2, 2026 consummation of its $210 million IPO of 21 million units at $10.00 per unit, including a 1.0 million-unit partial over-allotment exercise. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-half of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. The company entered underwriting, warrant, and trust agreements with Cohen & Company and Continental Stock Transfer. As a de-SPAC predecessor, the key watch item is identifying and announcing a target before the combination deadline.
